description.narrative: - Increased access to high-quality medicines: The Project is expected to make a strong contribution to improving access to quality pharmaceuticals in Mexico, addressing significant gaps in healthcare access and quality. By expanding domestic production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and injectables, the project strengthens the local supply of essential medicines, potentially reducing reliance on imports and potentially mitigating stock-outs in public healthcare facilities. - High demonstration effect on the importance, technical feasibility and financial sustainability of the API industry: The Project is poised to advance the evolution of Mexicos healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors by demonstrating the feasibility and benefits of local API production in a market that currently relies heavily on imports. Neolpharmas acquisition and modernization of an API plant, combined with its vertically integrated production model, could serve as a replicable example for other firms.

Grupo Neolpharma (Neolpharma or the Group) is a family-owned pharmaceutical company primarily operating in Mexico. It offers over 250 branded and generic medicines across various therapeutic areas, including central nervous system (CNS) diseases, cardiovascular diseases, oncology, and diabetes. In 2021, IFC financed Neolpharmas initial expansion plan, encompassing the construction of a new injectables facility in Mexico City, the expansion of an active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) production plant in Ecatepec, Mexico, and other related expenditures (#39128). IFC is now proposing a new $70 million long-term corporate loan to support Neolpharmas further expansion plan in Mexico (the Project). The Project includes (i) the acquisition, refurbishment, and reactivation of the NeolSym Civac API plant in Morelos (API Plant); (ii) the construction of a new injectables facility in Toluca to provide drug manufacturing services for a third party (CMO Plant); and (iii) technological upgrades and new equipment for Neolpharmas existing plants, including the refurbishing of corporate offices.
